definitions.explanation: any work that has been published and distributed, including books, journals, and periodicals

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}を{確認|かくにん}する。
この{研究所|けんきゅうしょ}の{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}は{無料|むりょう}で{閲覧|えつらん}できる。
examples.english: Publications from this research institute can be viewed for free.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}の{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}は{国立|こくりつ}{国会|こっかい}{図書館|としょかん}で{入手|にゅうしゅ}できる。
examples.english: Government publications can be obtained at the National Diet Library.

notes:
Composed of {刊行|かんこう} (publication/issuing) and {物|ぶつ} (thing/object). A formal term covering all types of published materials. The suffix {物|ぶつ} creates concrete nouns from abstract concepts, as in {印刷物|いんさつぶつ} (printed matter) and {出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ} (published materials).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政府|せいふ}{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}: government publication
- {定期|ていき}{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}: periodical, regular publication
- {刊行物|かんこうぶつ}リスト: list of publications
- {刊行物|かんこうぶつ}を{発行|はっこう}する: to issue a publication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}: published material — very similar, but {出版|しゅっぱん} emphasizes commercial publishing
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}: printed matter — broader, includes anything printed
- {書籍|しょせき}: books — specifically books, not periodicals or reports
